NONE: A1 unhappy or sorry
傷心的，悲哀的；令人難過的，令人遺憾的
› informal If something looks sad, it looks worse than it should because it is not being cared for.
可憐的，淒慘的

before noun: › [ before noun ] not satisfactory or pleasant
令人遺憾的；令人不快的

NONE: C1 something you say when you are telling someone about something bad that happened
真遺憾，可惜的是
› slang showing that you are not fashionable or interesting or have no friends
無趣的；乏味的；不受歡迎的
› abbreviation for seasonal affective disorder: a medical condition in which a person does not have much energy and enthusiasm during the winter because of the reduced period of natural light
季節性不適（冬季因日照時間縮短而引發的精力不濟，seasonal affective disorder的縮寫）

example: I've just received some very sad news.
我剛剛得到一些令人傷心的消息。
She gave a sad smile.
她露出一絲苦笑。
[ + (that) ] It's sad (that) the trip had to be cancelled.
很遺憾旅行被迫取消了。
I'm so sad (that) you can't come.
你不能來，我很遺憾。
[ + to infinitive ] It's sad to see so many failures this year.
今年看到這麽多失敗的事情真是令人難過。
I was sad to hear that they'd split up.
聽說他們分手了，我很難過。
Give those flowers some water - they're looking a little sad.
給那些花澆點水——它們看起來蔫巴巴的。
The sad fact/truth is we can't afford to provide homes for all.
令人遺憾的事實是，我們無法爲所有的人提供住所。
a very sad state of affairs
十分糟糕的時局
Sad to say, the ring was never found.
真可惜，那枚戒指一直沒有找到。
You enjoy reading timetables? You sad man!
你喜歡看時間表？你可真無聊！
Staying at home on a Saturday night is just sad.
星期六晚上呆在家裡真是無聊。

NONE: › boring and never likely to be successful
令人厭煩的，永遠不可能成功的

example: He's just some sad-sack writer trying to get a book published.
他只是一個總想著要出本書，但永遠成功不了的作家。

NONE: C2 to make someone sad
使悲傷，使難過，使傷心

example: [ + to infinitive ] It saddens me to think that we'll never see her again.
一想到我們再也見不到她了就令我非常傷心。
We are deeply saddened by this devastating tragedy.
這起令人震驚的悲劇事件使我們沈浸在深深的悲痛之中。

NONE: › If someone is sadder but wiser after a bad experience, they have suffered but they have also learned something from it.
經一事，長一智

C: C2 [ C ] a seat, often made of leather, used on a horse, bicycle, motorcycle, etc.
馬鞍；（腳踏車、機車等的）座墊，鞍座

C or U: › [ C or U ] a large piece of meat taken from the middle of the back of an animal

NONE: C2 to put a saddle on a horse
給（馬）套上馬鞍

example: He swung himself into the saddle and rode off.
他跨上馬鞍，騎馬走了。
See also
sidesaddle
The chairman is back in the saddle after his heart attack.
心臟病癒之後，主席又重新掌權了。
She saddled (up) the horse for her friend.
她爲朋友備好了馬鞍。

NONE: C2 to give someone a responsibility or problem that they do not want and that will cause them a lot of work or difficulty
使（某人）負擔，使（某人）承擔（重任或難題）

example: The company is saddled with debt.
公司負債累累。

NONE: › having a sore bottom from sitting on a saddle for a long time
（騎馬或騎車後）胯下痛的，（感到）坐鞍痛的
› a small bag that you fix to the back of your bicycle saddle, or one of a pair of bags that you put over the back of a horse or over the back wheel of a bicycle or motorcycle
鞍囊，馬鞍袋；（腳踏車、機車後座的）掛包，工具包
› a person who makes, sells, and repairs saddles and other leather objects for horses
鞍工；馬具工人；馬具商
› leather objects, such as saddles and bridles, for horses
鞍具，馬具
› someone, especially a man, who is not fashionable or interesting or has no friends
俗氣的人，乏味的人，不受歡迎的人（尤指男子）

example: People no longer think that computer games are just for saddos.
人們不再認為電腦遊戲是無聊的人才玩的東西。

NONE: › a Hindu holy man, especially one who has chosen to live apart from society
（印度教）聖人，苦行僧
› the activity of getting pleasure, sometimes sexual, from being cruel to or hurting another person
虐待狂；性虐狂
› a person who gets pleasure, sometimes sexual, by being cruel to or hurting another person
虐待狂者；性虐狂者
B2 in an unhappy way
傷心地，悲傷地
B2 in a way that is not satisfactory
令人遺憾地，令人傷心地

example: "He's gone away for six months," she said sadly.
「他已經走了六個月了，」她傷心地說。
Sadly, the treatment doesn't work for all patients.
很遺憾，這種治療並不是對所有的患者都有效。
If you think she'll let you do that, you're sadly (= completely) mistaken.
如果你認爲她會讓你那麽做，你就大錯特錯了。

NONE: › the activity of getting sexual pleasure from sadism and from masochism (= being hurt)
性施虐受虐狂
